---
title: Gallery
description: Complete apps built with shinywidgets, from single-widget templates to multi-widget showcases.
listing:
  id: gallery
  contents:
    - "showcases/*/index.md"
    - "templates/*/index.md"
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 2
  categories: true
  sort: false
  image-height: 230px
  max-description-length: 180
  page-size: 50
  fields: [image, title, description, categories]

Every app here runs as-is: open its page for the source, the widgets it uses, and how to run it. Showcases
combine several widgets into a full app; templates are small starting points for one pattern. Filter by kind
of widget with the categories on the right.
